status: reviewed against exact pinned source; native development probe pending
findings: The pinned keymap binds C-x C-w to filewrite. After filename entry, filewrite checks the resolved destination with stat and calls eyorn only when it already exists.

The confirmation text identifies the existing destination. A negative answer returns before writeout; a positive answer continues through writeout and updates the current buffer filename only after the write succeeds.

E10a answers no with a literal text action and checks both files unchanged. E10b answers yes with a literal text action after editing, then checks the original remains unchanged and the destination has exact edited bytes.
safety: synthetic files only under owned workspace; secure mode -S; backups disabled with -n
interaction_encoding: The public spec key action accepts named keys and Ctrl-letter chords only. Single-character yes/no responses must use a literal text action; the initial key="n" contract was rejected as invalid_spec before target launch and is preserved in e10-first-attempt-readback-v1.json.
